etymology.historical_story: Toorop is documented as a family name in European art history. Jan Toorop was born in Java in 1858, moved to the Netherlands in 1869, and developed from impressionist approaches toward symbolism. This biography supplies cultural context for one attested bearer of the name. It does not establish the surname's etymology or identify the source of the lowercase input.
